args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Seoul Hero future monster individual PNG artwork.
Primary request: A cute but threatening Seoul gate monster with three broad petal-shaped lobes joined around one deep center, each lobe a different size, with no appendages below. Anatomical material: three modern gray enamel utility-panel petal shells enclosing a flexible navy shadow creature. Each shell has plain blank yellow rectangular reflective insets, small steel screw fasteners and short folded utility fins. Three small amber eye lights are tightly grouped in the central depression. Modern industrial hardware, matte gray and navy, no gold metal, ornate armor, crown, symbols or decorative engraving. Face: three tiny eyes grouped tightly in the central depression. Single cohesive body silhouette, no legs, feet, knees, humanoid torso, walking joints or articulated limb rig. Front-three-quarter view, restrained inner magic light, thick readable edge and soft painterly shading. A few small material details must explain its theme rather than recolor another monster. Transparent background, no environment, text, props in hands, or ground pedestal. Designed for one shared float motion applied to the entire PNG.
Style: original crisp Korean mobile-game hand-painted raster art, strong readable silhouettes, clean navy outlines where appropriate, restrained cel shading and material highlights. Follow the specific subject palette in the brief. Create a new silhouette and object, with no copied reference subject.
One cute threatening legless monster. Absolutely NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO WALKING JOINTS, NO HUMAN ARMS. Single cohesive body, full silhouette visible, no floor shadow or ground plane.
Composition: single subject fully inside canvas, centered with 8 percent safe padding. No contact sheet or multiple examples.
Background: actual transparent RGBA, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, UI chrome, labels or numbers. Preserve the requested anatomy and view.
